title: Classic Quebec Poutine
description: The original comfort food from Quebec - crispy fries topped with fresh cheese curds and rich brown gravy.
ingredients: 4 large russet potatoes, cut into fries
instructions: Cut potatoes into thick fries, about 1/2 inch thick. Soak in cold water for 30 minutes.
Heat oil to 325°F (165°C) for the first fry. Fry potatoes for 3-4 minutes. Remove and drain.
Increase oil temperature to 375°F (190°C). Fry potatoes again for 2-3 minutes until crispy.
For the gravy: melt butter in a saucepan. Whisk in flour and cook for 2 minutes.
Gradually add beef stock while whisking. Add Worcestershire sauce.
Simmer for 5-10 minutes until thickened. Season with salt and pepper.
Place hot fries in serving dish, top with cheese curds, then pour hot gravy over top.

title: Shuba (Herring Under a Fur Coat)
description: A beloved Russian layered salad that's essential at New Year celebrations.
instructions: Boil potatoes, carrots, and beets separately until tender. Let cool completely.
Hard-boil eggs for 10 minutes, then cool. Separate whites from yolks and grate.
Peel and grate all vegetables using a coarse grater.
In a dish, start layering: spread chopped herring evenly on the bottom.
Layer chopped onion over herring, then spread a thin layer of mayonnaise.
Add layer of grated potatoes, then mayonnaise.
Continue with grated carrots and mayonnaise, then grated egg whites and mayonnaise.
Top with grated beets and a final layer of mayonnaise. Garnish with dill.

title: Guo Bao Rou (Sweet and Sour Crispy Pork)
description: A signature dish from Northeast China with perfectly crispy pork pieces coated in a glossy sweet and sour sauce.
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut into 2-inch strips
instructions: Cut pork tenderloin into strips. Season with salt and Shaoxing wine.
Make batter by mixing cornstarch, flour, egg white, and water until smooth. Coat pork.
Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). Deep fry pork pieces until golden, about 4-5 minutes.
Let oil temperature rise to 375°F (190°C) and fry pork again for 1-2 minutes.
For sauce: mix sugar, rice vinegar, soy sauce, and tomato paste.
Heat oil in wok. Add garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Pour in sauce mixture and bring to a boil until glossy and thickened.
Add crispy pork to wok and toss to coat. Serve immediately.
